events.text_en: Hộ Lâm Đường's wardens swear the rite of asking as their first law: no spirit tree is felled until a warden has spent a night beside it.
The brown bears of Tông Hùng Lâm come for a felled spirit log, and the warden Sư Tuyết Tùng stands over it until he dies.

The Grandmother Fir of Sơ Hiểu Lâm, the greatest spirit tree in the northern woods, is felled after a night of asking and burned in the Green Furnace on the night Úy Thanh Diễm forms his Nascent Soul. The drought had dried the green wood of the northern woods, so only the Fir would do. The hall says the tree said yes.
After the spring flood of 1161 takes half the rafts, Lục Thanh Sam writes the Raft-and-Root Primer for the hall's outer gate, in place of Thúy Vi's Seed and Soil Primer.
